'''Nodin Chavdri''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] member of the [[Resistance]] where he served as a [[shuttle]] and [[transport]] [[pilot]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Biography==
[[File:NodinChavdri-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Chavdri's transport delivers Resistance troops to battle First Order forces.]]
At some point during the [[Cold War]] between the Resistance and [[First Order]], Nodin Chavdri piloted a [[Resistance transport]] that delivered [[Resistance trooper]]s to a planet where they immediately engaged in battle with [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] and an [[First Order All Terrain Scout Transport|All Terrain Scout Transport]].<ref name="SWZ">{{FFGXW2|set=Resistance Transport Expansion Pack|cardname=Nodin Chavdri}}</ref> During the [[Battle of Oetchi]], Chavdri sided with [[Poe Dameron]] during Dameron's mutiny, but was later [[stun]]ned by [[Amilyn Holdo]], along with [[C'ai Threnalli]] and [[Pammich Nerro Goode]], after she caused a distraction. He participated in the [[Battle of Crait]], flying a [[V-4X-D ski speeder|V-4X-D Ski speeder]]. He [[Death|died]] during the battle along with several [[Resistance pilot]]s.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nodin Chavdri was portrayed by [[Navin Chowdhry]] in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />
